records.supportedMechanism: TARGET Services provide a concrete institutional and technical carrier for large-value payments, securities settlement, instant payments and collateral management at European scale.
contradictions: TARGET Services are Eurosystem/euro-area centred and must not be treated as proof of uniform carrier use across every EU member-state activity.
unknowns: Participation and usage vary by service and jurisdiction.

records.supportedMechanism: Current industrial production remains active across the EU even with weak momentum, while transport-network implementation and digital infrastructure provide ongoing routing and coordination conditions.
contradictions: Industrial output is near-stagnant at the aggregate level and infrastructure/digital maturity is uneven.
unknowns: Current evidence does not establish durable acceleration or uniform member-state performance.

records.supportedMechanism: High energy-import dependence and sharply rising energy-linked producer prices actively constrain the cost structure and flexibility of the current European industrial-economic runtime.
contradictions: Dependency and energy mix differ substantially across Member States.
unknowns: Duration of the 2026 price pressure and country-specific pass-through.

records.supportedMechanism: Energy import volumes and composition are changing, including lower petroleum volumes and higher LNG volumes, within a system that remains import-dependent.
unknowns: Current evidence does not yet establish a sufficiently complete adaptation-across-time mechanism for P3 admission across the EU energy system.

boundary: Mature carrier and active runtime evidence are distinguished from growth. Energy supply reconfiguration remains reference-only because current evidence does not yet meet the direct P3 continuity/adaptation threshold.
